comments.text: My experience with OpenRouter and free models hasn’t been great. They’re free, then they’re not, they get rate limited or are slow due to heavy traffic, etc. That lack of consistency for me is friction. What I have found to work well is using OpenCode pointed to OpenRouter, and one of the better models I’ve found that works well with good Skills files and doesn’t go off script is Qwen3.6 35B-A3B. Works quite well with good Skills files, especially for a small model, and is lightening fast. The full weights 27B Qwen is pretty good too, for the same reasons, but not as fast as the A3B, and I’ve gotten used to its speed. Claude Code and the Anthropic models have now become QC / QA for the Qwen work, as well as the initial ideation and to some extent research on the front end. I have found this combo to be an effective way to keep Claude costs well within reason while using the super cheap Qwen models for the bulk of the work. I had been doing the same thing with Opus and Haiku, and found that combo to be very effective and efficient as well. Not as cheap as Qwen, but still pretty cheap.
